texts: Leukopenia is not part of the toxicity profile of calcineurin inhibitors: C.

Cyclosporine and tacrolimus block T-cell activation without suppressing the bone marrow, so the white cell count is not lowered; leukopenia belongs to antiproliferative drugs such as azathioprine and mycophenolate.

Their typical toxicities are nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity such as tremor and seizures, hypertension, and post-transplant diabetes, more with tacrolimus, with hirsutism and gum overgrowth from cyclosporine.
In the picture, the cyclone-taco brings sugar, hair, a flickering lantern and dry kidney beans, while the ants' nest stays full.
Memory hook: the taco storm sweeps the ants away but never empties their nest.
